SATORICHARACTER-ENABLE_SPELL_VOICES.hove: Play the A3 Japanese voice when a spell card is played. Disabling stops the current voice immediately.
SATORICHARACTER-SPELL_VOICE_VOLUME.title: Spell voice volume
SATORICHARACTER-SPELL_VOICE_VOLUME.hover: 100% matches the previous version; the default 300% triples the gain. Also follows the game's SFX and master volume. 0% mutes voices.
SATORICHARACTER-ENABLE_SPELL_BANNER.hove: A rose-purple name banner drifts across the center and fades away. Rapid plays replace the previous banner. Mouse input passes through.
SATORICHARACTER-USE_JAPANESE_SPELL_NAMES: Show original Japanese names instead of the card title localized for the current game language. Voices always remain Japanese.
SATORICHARACTER-SPELL_BANNER_DURATION.ho: Total time including fades. Does not change card play speed or voice length.
SATORICHARACTER-SPELL_BANNER_SCALE.title: Banner text size
SATORICHARACTER-SPELL_BANNER_SCALE.hover: Adjust the spell name's text size. Long names shrink automatically to fit the screen.
SATORICHARACTER-ENABLE_FOURTH_CHAPTER.ho: Controls solo Standard runs. In multiplayer Standard runs, any Satori taking a Lost Heartstring opts the party into the garden after every Act 3 boss, independently of local toggles. Existing Act 4 saves remain playable.
SATORICHARACTER-ENABLE_CHAPTER_PREVIEW.t: Show Act 4 preview at rest sites
SATORICHARACTER-ENABLE_DIALOGUE_VOICES.h: Play Japanese speech for Satori and Koishi’s battle bubbles. Disabling stops it immediately. Companion bubbles are unvoiced.
SATORICHARACTER-DIALOGUE_VOICE_VOLUME.ho: Also follows the game’s master and SFX volume. Music is slightly lowered during speech; spell callouts do not overlap it.
SATORICHARACTER-SHOW_FINAL_BATTLE_BGM_CR: Show the artist in the music player. With the player hidden, briefly show title and artist after the opening dialogue.
SATORICHARACTER-HIDE_KOISHI_INTENTS.hove: On by default. Show one ? for all Koishi’s intents until execution. Turn off to show all true intents. Read Mind is unchanged.
SATORICHARACTER-SHOW_FINAL_BATTLE_MUSIC_: Previous, pause and next controls only in Koishi’s final battle. Music begins after the opening dialogue, cycles through the playlist in order and stops at combat end. Drag the title or background to move.
SATORICHARACTER-ENABLE_CHAPTER_PREVIEW.h: Solo only, off by default. Adds an Act 4 shortcut at rest sites in Acts 1–3. Skips remaining acts; use a separate preview run.
